reciprocated.description: Reverse triple present; no incompatibility at K.

clean-default.description: No reverse triple; the default conclusion is clean; no incompatibility at K.

conflict-conflicts-with.description: No reverse triple; the default conclusion is in conflict with conflicts-with over Cons.

conflict-subject-type.description: No reverse triple, value an item; the default conclusion is in conflict with subject type only.

conflict-contemporary.description: No reverse triple; the default conclusion is in conflict with a contemporary entry over Cons.

unknown-value.description: The value is an unknown value.

contemporary-no-1-january.description: A contemporary entry applies at K; latest death precedes earliest birth; no compared date on 1 January.

contemporary-1-january.description: A contemporary entry applies at K; latest death precedes earliest birth; a compared date falls on 1 January.

contemporary-several-dates.description: A contemporary entry applies at K, but the latest death does not precede the earliest birth.

subject-type-at-k.description: The subject type entry applies at K.

conflicts-with-at-k.description: The conflicts-with entry applies at K.

none-of-at-k.description: A none-of entry applies at K.
